description: Environment prerequisite (design 10.0) and the bit-identical GroupConvBlock refactor (design 4.2) that the streaming engine needs: GroupConvBlock.pre(x, training) and GroupConvBlock.conv_with_group_mean(x, mean, inner_clip=True); _split_call delegates to them with the same ops in the same order. Starts tests/test_predict_streaming.py with the refactor guard. Foundation for every later FEAT.
steps: Probe nibabel in tf_gpu: `python -c "import nibabel, numpy; print(nibabel.__version__, numpy.__version__)"` (was ModuleNotFoundError on 2026-11-01). If missing: call send_message severity 'warning' asking Jay to approve `conda activate tf_gpu && pip install nibabel==3.1.1` (WSL, changes his local env; needed by tests (b)-(d) and the existing tests/test_evaluation.py, which currently fails at import). Wait for the answer. After approval install and re-probe; if 3.1.1 does not import under numpy 1.23, report the error and ask again (next candidate nibabel 3.2.2, recorded as a deviation). Never weaken tests instead. Record the install in .agents/tasks/predict-script/findings-env.md (one paragraph).

BEFORE editing models/layers.py: create tests/test_predict_streaming.py with `import tests.tf_setup` first, and a module-level `_legacy_split_call(block, x, training)` that is a verbatim copy of today's GroupConvBlock._split_call body (models/layers.py lines 691-704 at HEAD 95e58c8; a comment names that commit). It may read only block._pre, block.conv (kernel, bias), block.strides, block.fp16_act_clip.

Refactor models/layers.py GroupConvBlock: add `pre(self, x, training=None)` returning `self._pre(x, training, concat=False)`; add `conv_with_group_mean(self, x, mean, inner_clip=True)` = the current split body after the mean: k = cast(conv.kernel, x.dtype), channels = int(x.shape[-1]), strides list, c = self.fp16_act_clip; if inner_clip: y = clip_fp16(conv3d(x, k[..., :C, :]), c) + clip_fp16(conv3d(mean, k[..., C:, :]), c) else the same two conv3d terms without the inner clips; return clip_fp16(bias_add(y, cast(bias)), c). `mean` is a [1, ...] tensor in x.dtype. `_split_call(x, training)` becomes: x = self._pre(x, training, concat=False); mean = tf.reduce_mean(x, axis=0, keepdims=True); return self.conv_with_group_mean(x, mean). Docstrings name design 4.2. No other change in models/.

In tests/test_predict_streaming.py add class TestRefactorGuard: for float32 and mixed_float16 blocks (policy set via models.precision.policy_scope when constructing), fp16_act_clip 0 and 100 (choose an input scale so the clip is active under float16 at 100: assert some |pre-clip| > 100), strides 1 and 2: build a GroupConvBlock(group=True, negative_slope 0.01, seed 0) on a fixed random [3, 8, 8, 8, 4] input, set split_group True, and assert_array_equal(_legacy_split_call(block, x, False), block._split_call(x, False)). Also TestConvWithGroupMean: `block.conv_with_group_mean(block.pre(x, False), mean_of_pre, inner_clip=block.split_group)` vs `block(x, training=False)` with split on (bitwise) and split off (allclose rtol 1e-5 float32; the concat path is different arithmetic); stem-like block (pre_activation=False): pre is identity.

In tests/run_tests_wsl.sh stage 2, right after the version print line (`python -c "import sys, tensorflow as tf ..."`), add: `python -c "import nibabel" || { echo "tf_gpu needs nibabel (pip install nibabel==3.1.1)"; status=1; }`. (The PYFILES / bash -n additions for the new files come in FEAT-005.)

Commit locally on main: `git add models/layers.py tests/test_predict_streaming.py tests/run_tests_wsl.sh .agents/tasks/predict-script/findings-env.md` and commit 'predict-script FEAT-001: GroupConvBlock.pre / conv_with_group_mean (bit-identical refactor), refactor guard, nibabel guard'. Never push.
